value.signature: const fn new (package : & 'static str , revision : Option < & 'static str > , tag : Option < & 'static str >) -> Self

exception.justification: Justified: This const constructor validates compilation inputs before an executable or observer exists.

review.body: { assert ! (tag . is_none () || revision . is_some () , "PN_BUILD_RELEASE_TAG requires PN_BUILD_SOURCE_REVISION") ; if let Some (value) = revision { let bytes = value . as_bytes () ; assert ! (bytes . len () == 40 , "PN_BUILD_SOURCE_REVISION must be a full lowercase Git commit name") ; let mut index = 0 ; while index < bytes . len () { let byte = bytes [index] ; assert ! ((byte >= b'0' && byte <= b'9') || (byte >= b'a' && byte <= b'f') , "PN_BUILD_SOURCE_REVISION must be a full lowercase Git commit name") ; index += 1 ; } } if let Some (value) = tag { let bytes = value . as_bytes () ; assert ! (! bytes . is_empty () , "PN_BUILD_RELEASE_TAG must be a distinct nonempty release tag") ; let untagged = b"untagged" ; let undescribed = b"undescribed" ; let mut is_untagged = bytes . len () == untagged . len () ; let mut is_undescribed = bytes . len () == undescribed . len () ; let mut index = 0 ; while index < bytes . len () { let byte = bytes [index] ; if index < untagged . len () && byte != untagged [index] { is_untagged = false ; } if index < undescribed . len () && byte != undescribed [index] { is_undescribed = false ; } assert ! (! byte . is_ascii_whitespace () && ! byte . is_ascii_control () , "PN_BUILD_RELEASE_TAG cannot contain whitespace or control characters") ; index += 1 ; } assert ! (! is_untagged && ! is_undescribed , "PN_BUILD_RELEASE_TAG must be a distinct nonempty release tag") ; } Self { package , revision , tag } }
review.item_premise: Compile-time inputs are immutable public metadata. The constructor refuses malformed revision, malformed tag spelling or an orphan tag before any executable can run.
